property_summary: The owner variable must equal the _owner argument after an admin calls setOwner; the bug always sets owner to address(0).
After a successful call to setOwner by the admin, the returned success value must be true; the bug returns false even though the owner was correctly updated.
The owner after setOwner can only be changed by the original admin; the bug allows the current owner to change the owner to any address.

After any address A calls setOwner on the reference contract, only the admin can change the owner again, making the owner immutable from A's perspective; the bug allows the caller (if made owner) to subsequently change the owner arbitrarily.
For any non-admin caller, setOwner must not change the owner; the bug lets any caller change owner.

For any two distinct calls to setOwner by the same non-admin sender, the owner after the second call must equal the second argument; the bug makes the first call succeed where the reference requires it to revert.
For any caller other than the admin, a call to setOwner must revert; the bug permits any caller to execute it and change the owner.
Any non-admin caller cannot change the owner; the bug allows any non-admin caller to change the owner.
For any non-admin caller, after calling setOwner, the original owner must remain unchanged; the bug allows a non-admin to change the owner.
For any caller that is not the original admin, a call to setOwner must revert; in the buggy version a non-admin call succeeds and changes the owner.

For any onlyAdmin caller, `setOwner` returns exactly the bool value written in its `return` statement; the reference always returns true, while the buggy version returns false (default) when the call succeeds.

After any sequence of setOwner calls by admin, owner() must return the last _owner argument; the mutant always returns the original owner, so after a single call with a different address the values diverge.

After a call to setOwner by the admin, the owner variable should always equal the argument _owner passed to the function; the mutant breaks this by setting owner to admin, ignoring _owner for any admin caller.
The setOwner function only updates the owner when called by the admin; the buggy modifier allows anyone to change it.
